Opinion of the Judge
As per final orders  JUDGMENT [Delivered on 31.12.2025]
The PSI of Vidhana Soudha PS has filed charge sheet against the accused for the offences punishable U/Sec.506, 120[B] of IPC.

2. Brief facts of prosecution case is as follows:
On the basis of first information/complaint given by CW.1, the Vidhana Soudha police had registered Cr.No.32/2021 against the accused for the O/P/U/Sec.376,
354[A], 354[D], 506, 504, 120[B], 420 of IPC and Sec.67[A] of IT Act.

In between 03.11.2021 to 15.11.2021, the accused made criminal conspiracy and threatened CW.
2 to 4 not to support CW.1 in that case.
On the basis of private complaint filed by the complainant, the Court referred the matter to the SHO of Vidhana Soudha police station for investigation.

Accordingly, the Vidhana Soudha police have registered this case in Cr.No.5/2022.
3.
After the investigation, the IO filed charge sheet against the accused.

The Court has taken cognizance of the offences punishable U/Sec.506,120[B]of IPC.
4.
On 30.06.2023 and 10.08.2023, the accused No.2 and 1 appeared before the court and got enlarged themselves on bail.
The Court complied with Sec.207 of Cr.P.C., and furnished charge sheet copies to the accused.
5. This Court heard both the parties.
As there were no grounds to discharge accused No.1 and 2, the Court framed charges against the accused for the offences punishable U/Sec. 506, 120[B] of IPC.
They did not plead guilty.
They claimed to be tried.
6. In order to prove its case, the prosecution got examined 6 witnesses as PW.1 to 6 and got marked Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.12 documents.
After the closure of the evidence of the prosecution, this court recorded the statements of accused No.1 and 2 U/Sec.313 of Cr.P.C., wherein, they denied the incriminating evidence led against them.
They did not choose to lead their defense evidence.
7. I have heard the arguments of Senior APP, Sri.MA and Sri.SS Advocates.

8. On the basis of allegations made against accused, the following points arise for my consideration:
1.

Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused made criminal conspiracy in between 03.11.2021 to 15.11.2021 and threatened CW. 2 to 4 not to support CW.1 in Cr.No.32/2021 of Vidhana Soudha police station, which was registered against them for the O/P/U/Sec.376, 354[A], 354[D], 506, 504,
120[B], 420 of IPC and Sec.67[A] of IT Act and thereby they have committed the offence punishable U/Sec.120[B], 506 of IPC?

19. In order to hold the accused guilty of the offences, the prosecution has to prove that, the accused agreed to do an illegal act and in pursuance of that agreement, the accused No.2 visited the office of PW.2 and threatened him not to support PW.1. Sec.120A of IPC deals with criminal conspiracy,
which reads thus:
When two or more persons agree to do, or cause to be done, [1] an illegal act, or [2]
an act which is not illegal by illegal means, such an agreement is designated a criminal conspiracy:

Provided that no agreement except an agreement to commit an offence shall amount to a criminal conspiracy unless some act besides the agreement is done by one or more parties to such agreement in pursuance thereof.
20. Contrary to the contents of Ex.P.1, the PW.1 in her evidence has stated that, the PW.2 forcibly took her signature to Ex.P.1/private complaint by beating and harassing her.

sentences.text: 30. In continuation of his cross examination, the PW.3 stated that, he had taken PW.2 to customs office and GST office when their products were seized.
He too admits that, he met the accused, when he had taken the PW.2 to those offices.
In their cross examination, the PW.2 to 4 have stated that,
accused No.1 and his wife never came to their office.
When such being the case, why the accused No.1 is arrayed as an accused to this case?

This fact has not been clarified by PW.2 to 4.
31.

The PW.3 stated that, neither himself nor PW.2 lodged any complaint to the police alleging that,
the accused No.2 and his wife threatened by visiting their office.
The PW.4 is none other than the office boy of PW.2.
The PW.4 in his cross examination has stated that, the PW.2 lodged the complaint before Vidhana Soudha police against accused No.2 and his wife regarding the threat given by them.
But the PW.2 did not say anything about lodging complaint before jurisdictional police by personally visiting the station.

32. The PW.2 did not explain the reasons as to why he did not lodge complaint before Indira Nagar police station after the alleged incident, which was allegedly occurred in his office and what was the necessity for him to approach Vidhana Soudha Police station?
In the present case, the complainant herself has turned hostile and stated that, she has forcibly signed Ex.P.1 on the sayings of PW.2 as he had beaten her and tortured her.
33. Nowhere the PW.3 and 4 stated that, the accused threatened them personally not to support PW.1 in Cr.No.32/2021 of Vidhana Soudha police station.

When such being the case, a question arises in the mind of the Court as to why, the present case came to be registered, when PW.3 and 4 were not threatened by the accused for supporting PW.1 in that criminal case.
34. Ex.P.1/Complaint came to be filed on 04.02.2022.
As contended by PW.2 to 4, if the alleged incident was occurred on 01.11.2021, they ought to have approached the jurisdictional police immediately and taken legal action against them.
But, they did not take such an action.

When the PW.2 is not an witness to Cr.No.32/2021 of Vidhana Soudha Police station, question of accused visiting his office and threatening him and asking him not to support PW.1 does not arise for consideration.
35. The PW.2 stated that, the accused No.1 threatened him by making phone calls and sending messages to his phone.
But, the IO did not collect any documents from PW.2 to substantiate his version.
The PW.5 and 6 deposed regarding the registration of the case and investigation conducted by them.
However, their version is not supported by the oral evidence of any independent witnesses.
Hence, the evidence led by PW.1 to 6 is no way helpful to the case of the prosecution.
From their evidence, the charges leveled against the accused are not proved.

36. Thus, the prosecution has failed to prove that, the accused made criminal conspiracy and threatened PW. 2 to 4 not to support PW.1 in Cr.No.32/2021 of Vidhana Soudha police station,
which was registered against them for the O/P/U/Sec.376, 354[A], 354[D], 506, 504, 120[B], 420 of IPC and Sec.67[A] of IT Act.
